question: Can the original static four-phase source retain charged CAR fields and the same time through a correlated register-number encoding, and what locality and interaction does that encoding actually preserve?
summary_de: Konstruktive korrelierte C4-Register/Teilchenzahl-Kodierung mit voller CAR und unveraenderter Zeit. Die tatsaechliche Sharp-Arc-Quelle braucht den Registerfaktor Z^(-q_j); naives D c_j verletzt CAR. Der reduzierte Hamiltonoperator ist global nicht quadratisch, aber auf jedem festen N frei: teilchenzahlabhaengige Randholonomie statt neu hergeleiteter lokaler Kraft. Neutrale Antwortkommutatoren erben uniforme lokale Ausbreitungsschranken; die volle geladene CAR-Netzlokalitaet bleibt wegen globaler Strings aus. Kein lokales Gauss-Gesetz oder P1/P2-Ursprung hergeleitet.
assumptions: Conditional C4 tensor Fock(V) lift of the frozen v1033 one-particle source
Unchanged register Hamiltonian; declared correlated register-number encoding and charged field algebra
All four C eigenspaces retained for complete source reconstruction; original D shifts s and is not superselected; no physical sector or vacuum selected
Original sharp arc u^4=I; its q_j is an arc indicator, not an electric charge assignment
Finite-degree finite-range QWZ source for uniform neutral response bounds
kills: Extend the product-preparation static trace obstruction to all correlated charged register encodings
Treat the naive original disorder product D c_j as a canonical fermion without its register phase
Interpret formal quartic occupation terms from a global number-dependent boundary phase as local collision or mediator dynamics
Obtain new neutral local bulk interaction by growing the same fixed-width free cylinder while its encoded cut recedes at fixed observation time
Identify the single global conserved C with a spatially resolved Gauss law or with a superselection charge of the full source algebra containing D
Infer a local charged CAR net or a thermodynamic observable-net construction from neutral response bounds alone
leaves_open: Source selection of the Fock lift, correlated encoding, physical field algebra and initial state
Physical local observable net and compatible charged string or gauge dictionary
Source-derived dynamics beyond fixed-number free evolution and global boundary holonomy
Same charge, group, state and time map to the E8/Spin10xSU4 composite-field and native-bank constructions
Complete 3+1D relativistic chiral dynamics, physical couplings and gravity
not_claimed: No universal obstruction to string-dressed charged fields or local gauge theories
No new Hamiltonian or independently selected mediator
No source-selected vacuum, central sector, preparation or physical time scale
No universal novelty claim; exact source-specific construction with standard algebraic methods

literature.title: O'Brien, Lootens and Verstraete, Local Jordan-Wigner transformations on the torus
Keilmann et al., Statistically induced Phase Transitions and Anyons in 1D Optical Lattices
